children: Kumar, who joined POWERGRID in 1994, brings more than 32 years of experience across power transmission, project execution and regional operations

Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID), a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power, has appointed Dharambir Kumar, Executive Director, as Head of the North Eastern Region Transmission System (NERTS), effective 18 September 2026.

Kumar joined POWERGRID in January 1994 and has more than 32 years of experience in the power transmission sector. He holds a B.Sc. Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering from B R Ambedkar Bihar University, Muzaffarpur, and was promoted to the position of Executive Director in July 2026.
During his tenure with POWERGRID, Kumar has served in various capacities across the North Eastern and Eastern regions, as well as at corporate and regional offices.
His experience spans substation maintenance, operation and maintenance, consultancy, transmission line and substation projects, and project execution.
Kumar has also served at Jiribam and Seppa in the North Eastern Region, alongside assignments in Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Gurgaon, Rajasthan and other locations.

In his new role as Head of NERTS, Kumar takes charge of POWERGRID's transmission system operations in the North Eastern Region. His appointment adds to his long association with the organisation and follows his elevation to Executive Director in July 2026.
